schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: A security release is worth interrupting the weekly schedule for.

packageRules.description: Patch and minor updates of runtime dependencies travel together; there is one reviewer and separate PRs for each would be noise.
Majors get their own PR: they are the ones that need reading.
Development tooling can move on its own; a broken linter fails CI and nothing else.
CI and runtime images are pinned deliberately, so surface them but never move them silently.
Python itself is a deliberate choice recorded in TALAIA.md, not a dependency bump.
